one_liner: Open-source CRM with workspace-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth2 and API keys, and an official MCP server. The cloud API needs a paid or trial plan, and self-hosting is free.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE and client credentials, with dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) and no dashboard setup. API keys are Bearer tokens created in Settings → Developers → API.
access_notes: There is no free cloud plan. One third-party source says API access starts on Cloud Pro, with a 7-day trial without a card or a 30-day trial with a card. Self-hosting is free with all Pro features, so a developer can get credentials that way.
blocker_notes: Cloud API use needs a paid Pro plan or a short trial. Each workspace has its own base URL and schema, so setup is per customer. Self-hosting is a free path.

evidence.quote: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access.
Create an API key in **Settings → Developers → API → + Create key**. Copy it immediately — it’s shown once.
Self-hosted Free: $0 with all Pro features (community support). No free cloud plan.
Create a Twenty account. API access starts on the Cloud Pro plan.
Core API — `/rest/` and `/graphql/` CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects.
Twenty exposes an [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server so that AI assistants — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, and others — can read and write your CRM data
